observation.visible_scene: A top-down view of a light wood-laminate floor. A large square mat of standing white dominoes displays a pixel-art BMW roundel (black outer ring, 'BMW' lettering at top, and blue/white quadrants in the centre). A rainbow-coloured line of dominoes traces the left edge, the right edge and the bottom edge of the white square, with a second parallel rainbow line lying just outside the bottom edge. The camera viewpoint is fixed throughout.
visible_changes: Frames 1–17 (t≈0–1.0 s): the entire arrangement is static; every domino, in both the white field and the coloured borders, remains upright and the logo is fully intact.
From about frame 18 (t≈1.1 s) a collapse begins at the bottom-left corner of the white square: a small patch of white dominoes tips over and lies flat.

The fallen region then grows steadily, spreading rightward along the bottom row and upward along the left column of the white square (frames 19–30), producing an expanding triangular zone of flattened dominoes in the lower-left.

The collapse front reaches the logo: the lower-left arc of the black ring is progressively knocked over (frames 31–38), and by frames 39–41 fallen dominoes begin to intrude into the inner circle's left (blue and white) quadrants.

Throughout, the top half of the logo, the right side of the white square, the right-hand rainbow border and the two outer bottom rainbow lines stay upright and unchanged; the coloured border at the bottom-left corner shows only slight local disturbance as the adjacent white dominoes fall.
No camera pan, zoom or cut is observed; the change is object motion (dominoes toppling) within a static frame.
outside_clip_unknowns: What initiated the collapse (no hand, push or impact source is visible in the segment) is unknown.
The final state of the structure after t≈2.67 s is not shown; the topple is still in progress at the last frame.
Whether the rainbow border lines were part of the same falling chain or only adjacent is not fully determined from this crop.
uncertain_details: Exact frame of first motion is between t=1.067 s (still intact) and t=1.133 s (first fallen corner).
The minor shift of the bottom-left coloured corner piece is hard to distinguish from the white dominoes falling behind it.
The propagation path inside the logo (whether it follows the ring or cuts diagonally through the white field) is only partially resolved at this sampling rate.
